ourStory.title: Preserving External Therapy Wisdom, Advancing Professional Exchange
ourStory.p1: The Chinese Medicine External Therapies Association of Australia is dedicated to preserving and promoting the rich wisdom and practice of Chinese medicine external therapies, including acupuncture, massage, cupping, gua sha, moxibustion, herbal applications, and aromatherapy. We believe that care from the outside in can support the balance of Qi and blood, awaken the body's natural healing potential, and promote holistic wellbeing.
ourStory.p2: The Association provides members with academic exchange platforms, training courses, public lectures, and industry resources, while advancing the standardisation, modernisation, and international development of Chinese medicine external therapies in Australia. We welcome practitioners, health professionals, and members of the public who value natural therapies to join us in preserving and renewing this important cultural heritage.

hero.title: Not Just Members, But Partners in Growth
hero.lead: Six major benefit modules covering learning, health services, professional development, community engagement, and giving back.

benefits.title: Continuous Community Connection Monthly
benefits.p1: The association plans to hold at least one public welfare activity, health lecture, or experience per month, in online, offline, and hybrid formats.
benefits.p2: Content may cover solar term wellness, book clubs, Guqin meditation, Zhanzhuang, Baduanjin, breathing exercises, special therapy experiences, and herbal workshops. Members can participate for free and enjoy priority registration and reserved spots.

benefits.title: From Hobby Experience to Professional Upgrade
benefits.p1: Members have priority registration for training, workshops, and cultural exchange activities hosted or partnered by the association.
benefits.p2: Courses include Family Health Doctor Foundation Class, Remedial Massage Therapist Certification Course, TCM Aromatherapist Course, Magnetic Cupping Therapist Training, AAM Meditation Course, and Zi Wei Dou Shu.

benefits.title: Covering Various Health Services
benefits.p1: Members can enjoy discounts on treatments such as acupuncture, massage, and moxibustion at cooperative TCM clinics, as well as discounts on aromatherapy studios, AAM meditation courses, personalized diet therapy, and wellness tea services.

benefits.title: Information, Exchange, and Professional Display
benefits.p1: Members will regularly receive health newsletters, join the association's internal communication platform, and participate in online Q&A sessions with senior TCM practitioners and aromatherapists.
benefits.p2: Professional members can also get personal and institutional display opportunities on the website or official account.

benefits.title: Giving Back to Society with Professional Skills
benefits.p1: The association will occasionally organize free clinics and public health projects. Members can sign up to serve or volunteer with priority, and have the opportunity to obtain volunteer service certificates and promotional support.

benefits.title: Expanding Cultural and Career Opportunities
benefits.p1: Members can priority participate in cross-border activities in the fields of culture, art, education, and wellness; those who actively participate in association affairs can receive honorary certificates. Professional members also have the opportunity to be priority recommended to partner institutions or external activities.

external.title: Chinese Medicine External Therapies
external.intro: Chinese Medicine External Therapies refer to a range of traditional practices that work through the skin, muscles, meridians, acupoints and other external pathways to support the body's natural ability to restore balance and maintain wellbeing. They include heat therapy, manual techniques, herbal applications, sensory stimulation, movement and lifestyle practices.
external.heroAlt: Traditional tools and botanical materials used in Chinese medicine external therapies
external.collectionIntro: Select a therapy to read its full introduction from the source document.
external.holisticTitle: The Holistic Approach of External Therapies
external.holisticP1: Chinese medicine external therapies are not limited to addressing a single symptom or body area. Traditionally, practitioners consider the individual as a whole, including constitution, lifestyle, environment, emotional wellbeing, diet and daily habits.
external.holisticP2: The goal is to support the body's natural balance and encourage people to become more aware of their own health, so that traditional health principles can become part of everyday life.
external.disclaimer: Note: Traditional Chinese medicine concepts described above represent traditional health practices and should not be interpreted as claims that these therapies can diagnose, prevent or cure specific medical conditions. Individual therapies should be undertaken appropriately and, where necessary, under the guidance of a qualified practitioner.
